hero.subtitle: Uniting hospitality businesses across eight districts of Sudurpashchim Province — elevating tourism, upholding standards, and advocating for our members.

aboutStrip.label: About HAN Sudurpashchim
aboutStrip.body1: The Hotel Association of Nepal — Sudurpashchim Province is the official body representing hotels, resorts, lodges, guest houses, and homestays across all eight districts of Province No. 7.
aboutStrip.body2: From the wildlife-rich plains of Kailali and Kanchanpur to the high Himalayan valleys of Bajura and Bajhang, we support businesses of every size and category.

services.label: Our Services
services.title: What We Do
services.subtitle: From setting quality standards to advocating for favourable policy — we work every day to strengthen hospitality across Province No. 7.

items.title: Quality Assurance
items.desc: Setting and enforcing hospitality standards across all member hotels in Province No. 7.

items.title: Tourism Promotion
items.desc: Promoting Sudurpashchim as a premier destination for domestic and international travellers.

items.title: Member Support
items.desc: Training, legal guidance, and business support for every registered member establishment.

items.title: Advocacy & Policy
items.desc: Representing hospitality businesses before provincial and federal government bodies.

whyVisit.label: Destinations
whyVisit.title: Why Visit Sudurpashchim?
whyVisit.subtitle: The province offers some of Nepal's most diverse natural and cultural attractions — from high Himalayan routes to protected wildlife reserves.

highlights.name: Shuklaphanta National Park
highlights.desc: One of Nepal's largest open grasslands, home to endangered wildlife.

highlights.name: Badimalika Temple
highlights.desc: A revered Shakti Peetha and major pilgrimage site set in the high hills.

highlights.name: Khaptad National Park
highlights.desc: Alpine plateau of meadows and forest — sacred to pilgrims and trekkers alike.

highlights.name: Mahakali River
highlights.desc: Pristine border river ideal for rafting and nature exploration.

highlights.name: Ramaroshan Lakes
highlights.desc: Sacred lake cluster in lush forests, perfect for spiritual tourism.

highlights.name: Ugratara Temple
highlights.desc: Historic temple and key cultural heritage of the far-western region.

hero.title: About Our Association
hero.subtitle: Since 1998, HAN Sudurpashchim has been the unified voice of hospitality businesses across the far-western region.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.body: To unite, represent, and empower the hospitality industry of Sudurpashchim Province through advocacy, quality standards, capacity building, and tourism promotion.
points: Maintain quality standards across all member hotels

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.body: To transform Sudurpashchim Province into a leading tourism destination in South Asia, recognised for world-class hospitality and authentic cultural experiences.
points: Sudurpashchim as a top eco-tourism destination
Preservation of cultural and natural heritage

history.label: Our Journey
history.title: History & Milestones
history.subtitle: Over two decades of serving the hospitality industry of far-western Nepal — growing from five founding hotels to a province-wide network.

timeline.desc: Established in Dhangadhi with 5 founding member hotels.
Membership expanded to all seven districts of the Far-Western Development Region.
Launched first regional campaign highlighting Shuklaphanta and the Kailash route.
Introduced hotel classification and quality standards for member establishments.
Re-registered as HAN Sudurpashchim Province (Province No. 7) after federal restructuring.
Launched digital platform to improve member visibility and booking capabilities.
Membership surpassed 15 registered hotels with ongoing expansion plans.
